item.title: Homeless numbers climb in West Virginia’s Northern Panhandle
item.description: NORTHERN PANHANDLE, W.Va. — Initial results from the annual Point-in-Time count show that more people than ever are homeless in West Virginia’s northern panhandle. Officials tell 7 News that at least 126 people are experiencing homelessness across Ohio, Marshall, Wetzel, Brooke and Hancock counties. Of those, at least 105 were counted in Ohio County alone.
